description: Data merge and variable data printing tools for Adobe InDesign. Enable automated document generation from data sources (CSV, Excel, databases) with field mapping, conditional logic, QR codes, barcodes, and batch processing. Critical for catalog generation, personalized marketing, and variable data workflows.

tools.name: indesign_create_data_merge
tools.description:
Initialize data merge workflow for document generation from data sources.

Sets up merge with:
- Template document selection
- Data source configuration (CSV, Excel, database)
- Field mapping between data and placeholders
- Merge preview options
- Output settings

This is the primary entry point for variable data printing workflows. The merge setup defines how data from spreadsheets or databases flows into InDesign placeholders (<<FieldName>>) to generate hundreds or thousands of personalized documents.

Use when:
- Creating product catalogs from inventory databases
- Generating personalized marketing materials
- Producing variable data print runs
- Automating document creation from data

Supports CSV files, Excel spreadsheets, and direct database connections. Field mapping allows flexible column-to-placeholder relationships.

Typical workflow: Create merge → Map fields → Preview → Execute merge → Export documents.

path.description: File path or database connection string

sheet_name.description: Excel sheet name (if type is excel)

field_mapping.description: Map data columns to InDesign placeholders

when_to_use: Creating product catalogs from inventory data
workflow: Step 2: Prepare data source (CSV, Excel, database)
Step 3: Call indesign_create_data_merge() with field mapping
best_practices: Map all placeholders to avoid empty fields
error_handling: Error 'Data source not found' → Verify path exists
Error 'Placeholder not mapped' → Check field_mapping completeness
Error 'Invalid data format' → Use indesign_validate_data_source() first

tools.name: indesign_map_fields
tools.description:
Configure or update field mapping between data source columns and InDesign placeholders.

Field mapping defines:
- Which CSV/Excel column fills which placeholder
- Data type conversions
- Optional field transformations
- Image path mappings

Use to establish or modify data-to-placeholder relationships.

workflow: Step 2: Call indesign_map_fields() to configure/update mapping
error_handling: Error 'Field not found' → Check source_field exists in data

tools.name: indesign_validate_data_source
tools.description:
Validate data source before executing merge.

Checks:
- File exists and readable
- Required columns present
- Data types match expectations
- Image paths valid
- No duplicate keys

Prevents merge failures by validating upfront.

tools.name: indesign_preview_merge
tools.description:
Preview data merge results before generating all documents.

Preview shows:
- Single merged record rendering
- Placeholder population
- Image placement
- Layout verification

Prevents wasting time on incorrect merges.

tools.name: indesign_execute_merge
tools.description:
Execute data merge to generate documents from all records.

Generates:
- Individual documents per record
- Multi-record documents (multiple records per page/document)
- Exported files in specified format
- Batch processing with progress tracking

This is the primary execution tool for variable data printing. After setup and preview, this generates the final output documents.

examples.description: Generate individual PDFs for first 50 records

best_practices: Use individual files for personalized items
error_handling: Error 'Merge validation failed' → Check data source
Partial success → Check errors array for failed records

tools.name: indesign_batch_merge
tools.description:
Process multiple data sources in batch for large-scale variable data printing.

Batch processing:
- Multiple CSV/Excel files
- Same template applied to all
- Parallel processing for speed
- Progress tracking per source

Optimized for high-volume production runs.

error_handling: Partial batch failure → Check per-source errors

tools.name: indesign_merge_to_pdf
tools.description:
Execute data merge with direct PDF export and PDF-specific settings.

Direct PDF merge:
- Bypasses .indd file creation
- Optimized PDF generation
- Custom PDF settings (compression, quality, marks)
- Faster for PDF-only output

Ideal when InDesign files aren't needed.

best_practices: Include printer marks for commercial printing
error_handling: Error 'PDF generation failed' → Check template validity

tools.name: indesign_merge_with_images
tools.description:
Execute data merge with image placeholder support.

Image merge features:
- Map image paths from data source
- Auto-fit images to frames
- Fallback images for missing files
- Image quality settings
- Batch image processing

Essential for product catalogs with photos.

workflow: Step 2: Ensure CSV has image paths
error_handling: Error 'Fallback not found' → Verify fallback_image exists

tools.name: indesign_conditional_merge
tools.description:
Execute data merge with conditional logic and rules.

Conditional features:
- Show/hide content based on data values
- Apply different styles conditionally
- Include/exclude records by criteria
- Dynamic layout adjustments

Enables sophisticated variable data workflows.

examples.description: Show premium badge only for high-value products

tools.name: indesign_merge_qr_codes
tools.description:
Generate QR codes dynamically during data merge.

QR code generation:
- Create QR codes from data fields
- Embed URLs, text, contact info
- Customize size and error correction
- Place in designated frames

Ideal for product tracking, marketing campaigns, event tickets.

examples.description: Generate QR codes for product URLs

workflow: Step 1: Add QR placeholder to template
Step 2: Ensure data has URL/text field
best_practices: Use high error correction for print
error_handling: Error 'QR field empty' → Check data has values

tools.name: indesign_merge_barcodes
tools.description:
Generate barcodes dynamically during data merge.

Barcode generation:
- Support for UPC, EAN, Code 39, Code 128
- Generate from SKU or product ID fields
- Customize barcode dimensions
- Include human-readable text

Essential for retail product catalogs and inventory.

workflow: Step 1: Add barcode placeholder to template
Step 2: Ensure data has valid codes

tools.name: indesign_export_merged_documents
tools.description:
Export merged documents in batch with custom naming patterns.

Batch export:
- Multiple output formats (PDF, PNG, EPUB)
- Custom file naming from data fields
- Organize by folders
- Parallel export processing

Streamlines post-merge export workflow.

examples.description: Export individual PDFs with product names

tools.name: indesign_merge_status
tools.description:
Check status of running or completed data merge job.

Status information:
- Job progress percentage
- Records processed count
- Estimated time remaining
- Error count and details
- Output file locations

Essential for monitoring long-running merges.

tools.name: indesign_cancel_merge
tools.description:
Cancel running data merge job.

Cancellation:
- Stops job immediately
- Preserves partially completed work
- Returns records processed count
- Frees server resources

Use when merge needs to be stopped.

error_handling: Error 'Job already completed' → Too late to cancel

tools.name: indesign_merge_error_log
tools.description:
Retrieve detailed error log for merge job.

Error log contains:
- Record-level errors
- Field-level issues
- Image errors
- Template problems
- Stack traces

Critical for debugging merge failures.

tools.name: indesign_resume_failed_merge
tools.description:
Resume merge job from last successful record after failure.

Resume features:
- Continue from failure point
- Skip already processed records
- Preserve completed output
- Retry failed records

Avoids re-processing successful records.

tools.name: indesign_merge_dry_run
tools.description:
Execute data merge in test mode without generating files.

Dry run validates:
- Data source integrity
- Field mapping correctness
- Template compatibility
- Resource availability
- Estimated execution time

Run before production merge to catch issues.

warnings: 3 images missing - fallback will be used

tools.name: indesign_schedule_merge
tools.description:
Schedule data merge job for future execution.

Scheduling features:
- Queue merge for specific time
- Recurring merges (daily, weekly)
- Timezone support
- Automatic retry on failure

Ideal for automated batch processing.

workflow: Step 3: Monitor scheduled_job_id at execution time
